method.feature_credit: Only Q contributes. N/A requires native format or runtime evidence. Attribute a scoped regression to the revision actually run. Source descriptors establish callable surfaces, not complete semantics. M for a native operation means no direct canonical operation was exposed in the examined build. Unknown applicability stays in the denominator.
method.current_vs_released: Use main SHA for source and release tag SHA for public binaries. Requirement 101 is explicitly about the public artifact. A previously qualified packaging or media regression cannot certify a whole repository.
method.counts: Blocked repositories have at least one B. Awaiting verification means at least one U or I. Latest qualified commit names evidence for individual features. A whole repository requires all applicable features Q.
method.continuation: Update this existing register by feature, retain evidence, run tools/render_provider_register.py and verify --check. Use the named working source and test paths for further programming.

native_requirements.102: Format sub-sector swap pages while preserving adjacent bytes, a partition tail and the full 32-bit last-page boundary.

qualification_evidence.result: Downloaded DEB SHA-256 matched GitHub. Production CORE.PROBE rejected the private blank image at both sector sizes. swap sector=512 result=2 variant=0 reads=5 violations=0 outstanding=0 | swap sector=4096 result=2 variant=0 reads=5 violations=0 outstanding=0
Inspected the generic AMD64 DEB, installed provider path, sole exported V2 entry, module descriptor and manual. Exercised its production probe at both sector sizes.
Exact-source workflow executed the native installer, built its provider locally and inspected the resulting package. Published RUN size and SHA-256 matched GitHub.

Preserve neighbouring bytes when swap pages are smaller than host sectors and accept partition tails and the inclusive last-page limit. Strict aligned 8 KiB callbacks, untouched partition tail and a header-only maximum-geometry host passed.

inapplicability.basis: Linux swap areas contain numbered pages. They have no file namespace, inode allocator, per-file metadata, snapshot/CoW tree or offline per-file relocation protocol. Live page ownership belongs to the VM subsystem.
The SWAP.so descriptor is hosted-only. A paging area cannot supply a BOOT executable or a mountable root namespace. The consumer must enforce this exclusion.
